description: rc.8 (F-03): a root member that the 0.0.7 mapping moves to x-legacy-<member> (adaptive_ai) beside an x-legacy-adaptive_ai the document already has: the move would drop one of the two values, so the document is code 2 (mixed spellings), whatever the member order (here x-legacy-adaptive_ai before adaptive_ai). Before the fix the result kept one value or the other depending on the order, with two different art_.
